integrity_note: Analytic proof and reproducible exact-rational finite checks; the finite checks do not certify the universal quantifiers. Distinct source methodology and bibliographic uncertainty are explicitly discussed.
scientific_limitations: Scalar equal-curvature finite-sum quadratic loss; exact full-data order statistic; independent uniform indices with replacement; Wasserstein uniqueness for finite-second-moment laws only. No optimizer consistency, vector extension, private-noise extension, or total-variation convergence in general.
title: Sharp median-rank Wasserstein contraction for empirical quantile-clipped SGD
